bundle.shortDescription: A desktop client for the Lore version control system
bundle.longDescription: TOME (Track, Own, Merge, Explore) is a community desktop client for Lore, the version control system by Epic Games: a Smartlog of your stack, branches and merges, locks, artist mode with Unreal asset thumbnails, and restack by drag and drop. Not made or endorsed by Epic Games.
